description: Move batch-8 n=2048 direct-FP32 rank-k launch binding below Python: build a shape-scoped extension entrypoint with prebound stage dimensions, strides, pointers, and caller-stream queue handling, exposing only a lightweight stage index between MathDx panel steps. Explore grouped orchestration where dependencies permit while preserving packed preparation, cached views, cleanup, every other dispatch, cross-shape resets, and all correctness and policy guards.

Bound the exact batch8 n2048 output and grouped pointer table once in the extension during packed preparation, then reduced each caller-current batched TRSM stage to a single panel index while retaining cached MathDx and CuTe launch objects. Build, kernelguard, official tests, fresh-input guard, and all 15 benchmark cells passed. Aggregate measured 927.036 us; batch8 n2048 measured 2278.600 us versus parent 2250.672 us.

Rebuilt the dynamic direct-FP32 CuTe host entrypoint around one cached output-base pointer plus a lightweight stage index; compiled host arithmetic now derives trailing dimensions, panel/trailing addresses, batch count, and physical strides below Python while cached panel/trailing views preserve lifetimes. Full validation and grid passed. Aggregate measured 924.833 us; batch8 n2048 improved to 2250.143 us from trial 0's 2278.600 us.

Hoisted caller-current CuTe queue resolution into the once-per-factorization n2048 binding, leaving each of seven rank-k calls with only its integer stage index while keeping MathDx and extension TRSM on the same caller queue. Full validation and grid passed. Aggregate measured 930.588 us; batch8 n2048 measured 2286.345 us versus 2250.143 us with per-stage queue checks.

Restored per-stage caller-queue checks and folded final n2048 lower-zero cleanup into the already-required stage-7 extension call, returning a cached transposed view. Local extension build and kernelguard passed, but Modal validation emitted no test result after its container banner for 1466.8 seconds and was terminated after exceeding the 1200-second ranked timeout; no benchmark metric was produced.

Rebuilt the n2048 rank-k host as a TVM-FFI tensor-plus-stage entrypoint using its caller-environment queue, eliminating Python pointer, scalar-wrapper, and queue arguments. Local build and kernelguard passed, but Modal import failed before test 0 because the production image lacks the optional tvm_ffi package; no benchmark metric was produced.

Cached each CuTe Int32 rank-k stage scalar in the shape-local n2048 table so the compiled base-pointer entrypoint receives no recurring scalar construction, while retaining per-stage caller-queue checks and cached panel/trailing views. Full validation and grid passed. Aggregate measured 932.172 us; batch8 n2048 measured 2308.380 us versus 2250.143 us before scalar caching.

Prebound all eight MathDx launch callables and seven direct-FP32 CuTe rank-k callables in the shape-and-caller-queue cache, including output pointers, scalar stages, launch dimensions, and one shared caller handle; recurring orchestration retained only stage-index extension calls. Full validation and grid passed. Aggregate measured 934.739 us; batch8 n2048 measured 2316.999 us versus 2308.380 us with scalar-only caching.

Retried grouped orchestration from the validated stage-index base: stage 7 now launches lower-zero cleanup inside the already-required extension call and returns a shape-cached transposed output view, removing the separate finish call. Build, policy, full validation, and all cells passed. Aggregate measured 933.439 us; batch8 n2048 measured 2324.200 us versus the base's 2250.143 us.

Completed eight measured n2048 launch-binding trials plus two logged validation failures. Best measured ca0b14f reached 924.833 us aggregate and batch8 n2048 2250.143 us, versus parent 923.038/2250.672; it binds one output-base pointer plus stage index in compiled CuTe host arithmetic and binds TRSM tensors once in the extension. Tensor/scalar/caller-queue callable prebinding measured 932.172-934.739 us; queue hoisting measured 930.588; cleanup fusion revalidated at 933.439. TVM-FFI caller-environment binding could not import because production lacks tvm_ffi, and one earlier cleanup attempt timed out before a successful retry. Local profiling remained waived. Keep going with CuTe's dependency-free exported C ABI linked into a shape-local extension, direct driver-handle launch extraction, or a single generated host entrypoint that sequences cublas TRSM then CuTe rank-k while retaining caller-current ordering.
